entries.title: India-only data storage restriction
entries.summary: AtliQ must store all Company Data (including borrower, loan account, and collections data) exclusively within India in compliance with applicable local laws and RBI directions.
entries.quote: The Service Provider shall comply with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, the Information Technology Act, 2000 and applicable RBI directions in processing Company Data, and shall store Company Data only in India.

services: Collections analytics data mart design and build

relatedClauses.quote: "Company Data" means all data, including borrower data, loan account data and collections data, provided by or on behalf of the Company.

entries.notes: Company Data is restricted to storage in India only, driven by DPDP Act 2023 and RBI outsourcing/IT guidelines.

entries.title: 6-hour security incident reporting window
entries.summary: AtliQ must report any detected security incident involving Company Data or systems to Trustline NBFC within six (6) hours.
entries.quote: The Service Provider shall report any security incident to the Company within six (6) hours of detection.

services: Collections analytics data mart design and build

entries.notes: The 6-hour incident reporting timeline is exceptionally short and demanding.

entries.title: Regulatory and corporate audit rights
entries.summary: Trustline, their external auditors, and the Reserve Bank of India have the right to inspect and audit AtliQ's facilities and records related to the Services.
entries.quote: The Company, its auditors and the Reserve Bank of India shall have the right to inspect and audit the Service Provider's records and facilities relating to the Services.

services: Collections analytics data mart design and build

entries.notes: Audit rights directly extend to a government regulator (RBI) and the counterparty's external auditors.

entries.title: RBI KYC customer data usage restriction
entries.summary: AtliQ must restrict its use of customer KYC information solely to performing the contract's services and is forbidden from using it for any other purpose.
entries.quote: The Service Provider acknowledges that Company Data includes customer information protected under the RBI Master Direction – Know Your Customer and shall not use it for any purpose other than performing the Services.

services: Collections analytics data mart design and build

relatedClauses.quote: This Clause 8 shall survive for five (5) years after termination.

entries.notes: Subject to a 5-year post-termination survival clause as outlined in Section 8.3.

entries.title: Subcontracting and assignment restriction
entries.summary: AtliQ cannot delegate, subcontract, or transfer its performance obligations under this agreement without prior written approval from Trustline NBFC.
entries.quote: Neither Party shall assign or subcontract this Agreement without prior written consent of the other.

services: Collections analytics data mart design and build

entries.notes: Prevents any off-shoring or third-party sourcing of operations without explicit counterparty sign-off.

referencedButMissing.note: Referred to in §2.3; these policies are binding on AtliQ but not attached to the master agreement.
